learn.explainer: Post-quantum refers to preparing for a transition to cryptography designed for a future with quantum computers. The item says joint guidance can help organizations assess vendor readiness.
Amphibious warships are vessels associated with carrying out amphibious missions. The item reports that USMC leadership says the current fleet needs to grow.
Hybrid warfare is a term used for warfare involving different forms of activity. The item mentions recent hybrid warfare attacks while reporting concern over hoax threats disrupting air traffic.

analysis.headline: Disruption, Readiness and Operational Capacity
paragraphs: The stories span air traffic disruption, cyber preparedness, critical infrastructure and military capacity. The hoax threats have no known claimant, while the refrigeration warnings identify systems under active targeting. Together, they show why analysts must distinguish reported activity from confirmed attribution.

The post-quantum guidance focuses on assessing vendor readiness; the refrigeration advisories point to present-day hardening needs. For defenders, these are different planning horizons, but both make supplier and system reviews relevant. The available snippets do not specify the detailed measures in the guidance.

The other stories add context on operational reach and political priorities: the USMC says it needs more amphibious warships, and China’s helicopter fleet is described as gaining reach and flexibility. Watch for further detail on the air traffic disruptions, vendor guidance and infrastructure warnings.
takeaways: Separate confirmed details from uncertainty about responsibility for the air traffic disruptions.
Assess vendor readiness and review refrigeration and cold-chain system security.
Track how reported military capacity needs and capabilities develop.
